repairs.quote: Jhin fires a long range shot dealing (70/105/140/175/210 + (50% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first champion hit and other enemies along the way. If this skill strikes a champion that has been damaged by an allied champion within the last 4 seconds, it will Root them for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.25 seconds and grant Jhin Whisper's Move Speed. This ability deals 75% damage to minions. Champions that step on a trap from Captive Audience can also be rooted.
